orderStatusPage.metaDescription: Check the status of your BAIA order with your order number and email.
orderStatusPage.title: Track your order
orderStatusPage.intro: Enter your order number and the email you ordered with to see the order status, delivery details and tracking number.
orderStatusPage.hint: Your order number is in your order confirmation email (it starts with BA).
orderStatusPage.whereBody: In the order confirmation email we sent after payment. Members can see every order in their account.
orderStatusPage.cancelBody: Cancel free of charge within {hours} hours of payment, as long as the order hasn't shipped.

cancelOrderPage.metaDescription: Cancel a BAIA order: instant free cancellation inside the cancellation window, or a cancellation request under Israeli consumer law.
cancelOrderPage.title: Cancel an order
cancelOrderPage.intro: You can cancel free of charge within {hours} hours of payment, as long as the order hasn't shipped. After that we'll handle your cancellation request under the Israeli Consumer Protection Law.
cancelOrderPage.formHint: We'll check your order before anything happens. If it's still inside the cancellation window you can cancel instantly.
cancelOrderPage.chooseLegend: How would you like to cancel?
cancelOrderPage.instantBody: The order is cancelled right away and the full amount refunded.
cancelOrderPage.requestTitle: Send a request - we'll call you
cancelOrderPage.requestBody: Rather talk to us first? We'll get back to you within one business day.
cancelOrderPage.doneCancelledBody: The full amount will be refunded to your payment method within a few business days. We've emailed you a confirmation.
cancelOrderPage.doneCancelledUnpaidBody: Your order was cancelled and you were not charged. We've emailed you a confirmation.
cancelOrderPage.doneRequestedBody: We'll get back to you within one business day. We've emailed you a confirmation.
cancelOrderPage.policyFreeBody: Within {hours} hours of payment, and as long as the order hasn't shipped, cancellation is instant with a full refund.
cancelOrderPage.policyShippedBody: You can cancel up to 14 days after receiving your items. Return them in their original condition and packaging.
cancelOrderPage.policyLawBody: After the free window, a cancellation fee of 5% of the price or ₪100 (whichever is lower) may apply under the Consumer Protection Law.
